summary: Tested GATE password (backend + frontend) and R4/iframe changes. GATE fully working: /api/site-lock/status returns correct payload; /api/settings public strips site_lock_password; POST /api/site-lock/unlock returns 401 Password errata on wrong pw and {ok:true} on correct pw; frontend SiteLockGate renders on / when locked=true with password input & submit button; /admin and /accedi correctly bypass the gate; correct password unlocks the site. HOWEVER two claims from the request are NOT reflected in the code: (a) R4 in /app/frontend/public/glitz-interattivo.html is still at schematicPosition:[615,470] planPosition:[566.256,410.8066] (NOT the requested [638,502]/[590.6,434.5]); (b) /app/frontend/src/components/Floorplan3D.jsx iframe cache-bust is still ?v=26 (NOT v=27).

minor.issue: When site_locked=false, endpoint returns {ok:true} regardless of body (even wrong password). Not a bug per current design/short-circuit, but worth noting.

action_items: Update /app/frontend/public/glitz-interattivo.html: change R4 (first zone group, IDs R1..R4) from schematicPosition:[615,470] planPosition:[566.256,410.8066] to schematicPosition:[638,502] planPosition:[590.6,434.5] to align R4 with R1/R2/R3 as user requested.
Bump cache-bust in /app/frontend/src/components/Floorplan3D.jsx iframe src from v=26 to v=27 to match the new HTML.
Optional: add a GET /api/admin/settings endpoint so the admin UI can read back site_lock_password (currently only PUT exists).
critical_code_review_comments: site_lock_unlock short-circuits when site_locked=false and returns {ok:true} even when password field is empty/missing/wrong. Consider consistent semantics or explicit 200 with reason.
PUT /api/admin/settings response body includes site_lock_password in cleartext (admin-only, acceptable) but public /api/settings correctly strips it — good.
test_credentials: Admin: jalucas@hotmail.it / GlitzAdmin2026!. Test site lock pw used during testing: TEST_pw_2026 (site restored to unlocked=false and pw remains in DB as TEST_pw_2026 — main agent may want to overwrite with user's real pw).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend gate endpoints & SiteLockGate frontend work end-to-end. Remaining action items are: (1) R4 coordinates in glitz-interattivo.html were NOT updated to [638,502]/[590.6,434.5] as claimed — still at [615,470]/[566.256,410.8066]; (2) Floorplan3D iframe cache-bust still v=26 not v=27; (3) site_lock_password in DB was overwritten to 'TEST_pw_2026' during testing — main agent should tell user to reset it to her chosen pw via /admin.
